MSG90.description: A ruggedized version of a sniper rifle intended for use in rapid-response operations such as hostage situations. Has a standard 20 round magazine, deep reserves, and a slightly faster fire rate, countered by strong recoil.
MSG90.name: MSG90

VSS VINTOREZ.description:
A DMR variant of the AS VAL intended for special operations where normal sniper rifles aren't viable. Fully automatic capable. Fast fire rate and high damage, with high recoil and low velocity.
Felt recoil is lower in semi-automatic than in automatic.
VSS VINTOREZ.name: VSS VINTOREZ

SKS.description: A modernized Tapco version of the traditional SKS carbine that saw use in WWII. Light recoil with moderate reserves and faster fire rate, but lower damage.
SKS.name: SKS

SCAR SSR.description:
A heavy precision variant of the Belvaunian MK17 SOCOM. Slowest fire rate in class with strong vertical recoil, but with fast recovery.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR SSR.name: SCAR SSR

SAIGA SAR.description:
The Saiga Semi-Automatic Rifle sometimes referred as 'Saiga Sporters' is a sport version of the Zarovian AK family available in a wide selection of calibers!
The base .308 Win. ammo offers the greatest damage especially up close but you can change the caliber for a different playstyle of your choice!
SAIGA SAR.name: SAIGA SAR

MK11.description: A Grand Federation AR-10 platform rifle firing the 7.62 NATO round. Snappy, fast recoil and deep magazine with middling fire rate.
MK11.name: MK11

SVK12E.description:
A speculative DMR development of the AK-12 prototypes and based loosely on the development of the SVCh and AK-308 systems which would follow. The SVK-12 is chambered in 7.62x54mmR and has a fairly typical AK-12 trigger group, allowing it to be used in semi-auto, burst, and full-auto to varying efficiency.

High damage with somewhat high recoil.

Model submitted by Rialag
SVK12E.name: SVK12E

BREN 2 PPS.description:
A DMR variant of the VZ.806 rifle system, firing 7.62x51mm NATO.

Relatively lightweight with strong damage performance and a high rate of fire, but somewhat floaty recoil.
Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
BREN 2 PPS.name: BREN 2 PPS

SA58 SPR.description:
A semi-automatic FAL submitted for Grand Federation military trials. Features a high fire rate and deep reserves, but becomes unstable under rapid fire and reloads slowly.
Will instantly kill to the head up close!

Model submitted by Rialag!
SA58 SPR.name: SA58 SPR

attachmentModifiers.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better equip, aim, walkspeed, and recoil recovery speed.
Accuracy is hindered from the lack of a stock.
